crossRefs.note: O Yahweh, don’t your eyes look on truth? You have stricken them, but they were not grieved. You have consumed them, but…
Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and said to him, “This is what Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, says: ‘How long will…
Or else, if you refuse to let my people go, behold, tomorrow I will bring locusts into your country,
Yahweh said to Moses, “How long do you refuse to keep my commandments and my laws?
Shall his recompense be as you desire, that you refuse it? For you must choose, and not I. Therefore speak what you…
Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;
If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the good of the land;
but if you refuse and rebel, you will be devoured with the sword; for the mouth of Yahweh has spoken it.”
See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how…
Therefore Yahweh says, “If you return, then I will bring you again, that you may stand before me; and if you take out…
Only know for certain that, if you put me to death, you will bring innocent blood on yourselves, on this city, and on…
God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and will he not do it? Or…
Behold, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.
‘If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond Yahweh’s word, to do either good or bad…
But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.
The children are impudent and stiff-hearted. I am sending you to them, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord…
They, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse, for they are a rebellious house, yet they will know that…
You shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse; for they are most rebellious.
“Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them…
When they opposed him and blasphemed, he shook out his clothing and said to them, “Your blood be on your own heads! I…
Therefore I testify to you today that I am clean from the blood of all men,
for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.

translations.kjv: But if thou refuse to go forth, this is the word that the LORD hath shewed
translations.asv: But if thou refuse to go forth, this is the word that Jehovah hath showed me:
